data.name: Anasi
data.gender_notes: Anasi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-n' meaning 'to love'. This name signifies a deep sense of love and affection. In Islamic history, Anasi is also known as a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a symbol of loyalty and devotion. The name Anasi carries the meaning “Loved one, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anasi usually hope their child will grow to embody loved one, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the love and devotion one should have for Allah and His Prophet.
data.etymology: Anasi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loved one, Beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anasi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يدل على الإنسانية والتواصل مع الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أناسي مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أنس' الذي يعني الأنس والتواصل. يدل على الشخص الذي يأنس بالناس ويتواصل معهم بسهولة ويسر. هذا الاسم يحمل معاني الوداد والتواصل الإنساني في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: اناسی
in_urdu.meaning: انسانی تعلقات اور لوگوں کے ساتھ رابطہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اناسی نام عربی جڑ 'أنس' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے انسانی تعلقات اور لوگوں کے ساتھ رابطہ۔ یہ نام انیس اور دوست بنانے کی سہولت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام انسانوں کے ساتھ پیار اور رابطہ کرنے کی اہمیت کو اُجاگَر کرتا ہے۔

in_pashto.name: اناسي
in_pashto.meaning: د انسانانو سره د اړيکو ټينګول
in_pashto.long_meaning: اناسي نوم د عربي ريښې 'أنس' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د انسانانو سره د اړيکو ټينګول معنی لري. دا نوم د خلکو سره د دوستۍ او اړيکو جوړولو توانایی څرګندوي. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د انسانانو تر منځ د مينې او تفاهم په معنا دی.

Historically, it has been used to denote individuals known for their amiable and approachable nature.

historical_references.reference: Anasi was a legendary figure in pre-Islamic Arabian folklore, often considered a sage and healer. He was said to be the son of Set, the god of desert and oasis, and to have lived in the time of the ancient Arabian city of Ukaz.
historical_references.time_period: Pre-Islamic Arabia, possibly 4th or 5th century CE
historical_references.context: Anasi was revered in pre-Islamic Arabian culture as a wise healer and sage.

historical_references.reference: Anasi is also mentioned in Islamic literature, notably in the works of Ibn Battuta and Ibn al-Jawzi, as a descendant of Prophet Hud (as) and a companion of Prophet Salih (as). He is said to have been a just king and a wise ruler who led his people to prosperity in the land of Yemen.
historical_references.context: Anasi is also known in Islamic tradition as a just and wise ruler in Yemen, a descendant of Prophet Hud.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Anasi' is derived from an ancient Islamic folklore character, Anasi al-Mawsili, known for his cunning and storytelling abilities. In modern contexts, this name is seen on various platforms that reflect the character's literary and cultural heritage. Anasi is a popular character in the 'One Thousand and One Nights' tale collection. Today, his name is used in digital media and social networks as a tribute to Islamic culture and storytelling. Three such platforms are 'Mawjoudin', an Islamic digital encyclopedia, 'Anasitron', a platform for Islamic stories and discussion, and 'Islamic Storytelling Platform', a dedicated space for sharing and creating Islamic tales. These platforms contribute to the revival of Islamic culture and serve as digital spaces for literature and storytelling.
